name: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad
overview: 2026年KLK的公告主要围绕种植板块的月度产量披露，鲜果串、棕榈油和棕榈仁产量同比均有增长，而橡胶产量同比下降。此外，公司多次提供财务援助并披露重大诉讼，但未涉及业务扩张、新业务或出售。
overview_en: In 2026, KLK's announcements mainly comprised monthly production disclosures for the plantation segment, with fresh fruit bunches, crude palm oil and palm kernel production increasing year-on-year while rubber production declined. The company also provided financial assistance multiple times and disclosed material litigation, but there were no announcements on business expansion, new businesses or divestments.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 2026年持续披露月度及季度产量，鲜果串、棕榈油和棕榈仁产量同比增长，橡胶产量同比下降。
segments.note_en: In 2026, monthly and quarterly production was continuously disclosed; fresh fruit bunches, crude palm oil and palm kernel production increased year-on-year, while rubber production decreased.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended September 2026, fresh fruit bunches production was 1,678,848 mt, up 16.40% year-on-year; crude palm oil 415,845 mt, up 19.17%; palm kernel 80,027 mt, up 22.33%; rubber 484,208 kg, down 46.41%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, fresh fruit bunches production was 1,465,566 mt, up 1.95% year-on-year; crude palm oil 366,571 mt, up 2.84%; palm kernel 70,309 mt, up 4.61%; rubber 456,622 kg, down 37.63%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended March 2026, fresh fruit bunches production was 1,335,233 mt, up 6.42% year-on-year; crude palm oil 335,328 mt, up 11.99%; palm kernel 64,661 mt, up 14.48%; rubber 594,491 kg, down 36.37%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended December 2025, fresh fruit bunches production was 1,578,282 mt, up 6.47% year-on-year; crude palm oil 384,024 mt, up 7.29%; palm kernel 73,409 mt, up 9.79%; rubber 709,245 kg, down 31.87%.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 2026年多次提供财务援助并披露重大诉讼，与具体业务板块无直接对应。
segments.note_en: In 2026, financial assistance was provided multiple times and material litigation was disclosed, with no direct correspondence to specific business segments.
